additions.title: Items report PDF export truncates to the current page (10 rows) — no paginate=0 normalization, same bug as the on-screen footer
additions.evidence: Surfaced + verified by the self-audit completeness reviewer: the items PDF export path does not force a full dataset (the merge override lives only in the Excel export), so it inherits the screen's paginate=1 and exports only the visible page — mirroring the confirmed on-screen S5-01 footer truncation.
additions.why_it_matters: A 'full items report' PDF that silently contains only 10 of 45 items is a wrong fiscal/management document; the owner would act on incomplete figures.
additions.reproduction: Open items report (45 items), export PDF -> only the first page's rows appear
additions.recommended_correction: In ItemsReportController::pdf, $request->merge(['paginate'=>0]) before itemReport(), exactly like the Excel export.

additions.title: Kiosk-machine edit prefills a password from a nonexistent field (re-instated wrongly-dropped)
additions.evidence: Re-instated by the self-audit safety-net reviewer with corrected citation: the edit() handler references a machine field that does not exist on the payload, so the edit form prefill is broken.
additions.why_it_matters: Editing a registered kiosk/borne is part of the owner's current terminal-association workflow; a broken prefill makes editing error-prone.
additions.reproduction: Settings -> Kiosk machines -> edit a machine; inspect the prefilled fields
additions.recommended_correction: Bind the edit form to the real machine fields returned by the API; verify against KioskMachineResource.
